exact_statement: For every uniform finite Boolean sign F and original proper coordinate pair A, let W be the outside translation space, c(v)=P[F(X)!=F(X+v)], b(q)=min_{v+W=q}c(v), mW the minimum c-cost basis of W and mQ the minimum b-cost basis of V/W. Then J_A(F)=mW+mQ is exactly minimum input-affine influence preserving the ORIGINAL query partition, and each minimum is its threshold-rank integral. For a source f, rematch one complete original cofactor by s*chi_v and call the resulting actual Boolean root F, retaining all four full signed Fourier rows. Set Delta=I(F)-I(f), R=I(F)-J_A(F)>=0. If f is initially joint input-affine/cubic-phase D_K maximal, or stationary under these composites, K>0, then H(F)-H(f)<=K(Delta-R). Thus Omega=H(f)-H(F)+K Delta pays the explicit KR interface. Let t be mean full affine/character minimum child influence, S* the complete optimized child reserve and L_F the full rematched entropy decrement. The exact ORIGINAL-source bank is D_K(f)+S*=L_F-K(J_A(F)-t)+Pi, Pi=Omega-KR. With old booked0<=u<=R it is L_F-K(J_A(F)+u-t)+(Pi+Ku). Pi>=0 under initial joint stationarity, and S*>=0 under genuine least dimension. A genuine3bit global D2-maximizer negative only at000, rematched on original branch1 by its outside character, has new support{0,5}, Hnew2,Inew3/2,J1,R1/2,S*=0; the new pair is exactly paid while the original positive deficit remains Pi. This refutes dropping Pi, not FEI or a sufficiently-high-K theorem. Prior version2 component-crossing payment remains valid for fresh labels of F transported through INPUT maps; old labels cannot be carried through a sign-changing phase. Universal pair selection/full FEI not asserted.
